title: Battle of Azukizaka (1564)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Azukizaka (1564)", at revision 1370107284, opens: "The Battle of Azukizaka  or Battle of Batō-ga-hara  took place on 15 February 1564, when Matsudaira Motoyasu, sought to destroy the growing threat of the Ikkō-ikki, a league of monks, samurai, and peasants who were strongly against samurai rule." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2762407, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle that took place on January 15, 1564, when Matsudaira Motoyasu (later renamed Tokugawa Ieyasu), sought to destroy the growing threat of the Ikkō-ikki". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
